OpenAI just split its flagship into three.

The GPT-5.6 family is not one model. It is three — Sol, Terra, and Luna — each built for a different tier of enterprise need. Flagship reasoning. Balanced general-purpose. Cost-efficient production.

This is the first time OpenAI has shipped a multi-tier product strategy, and it changes how every business should think about AI deployment.

The old question was: "Which provider's model is best?" The new question is: "Which tier do we route each workload to?"

Enterprises that build intelligent routing between these tiers will cut AI spend dramatically while maintaining output quality where it matters. Those that run everything on the top tier will overpay — significantly.

Initial access is limited to government-approved partners. General availability is coming. The window between now and then is your strategy window.

GYanTech AI builds model selection and routing strategies for enterprises navigating exactly this shift. Link in bio.
